hooks.command:
jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty' | grep -Eq '(^|[[:space:];&|(])git[[:space:]]([^;&|]*[[:space:]])?commit([[:space:]]|$)' || exit 0
cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" || exit 2
export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"
logs=$(mktemp -d)
make lint > "$logs/lint.log" 2>&1
lint=$?
make test > "$logs/test.log" 2>&1
tests=$?
[ "$lint" -eq 0 ] && [ "$tests" -eq 0 ] && exit 0
echo "git commit blocked: make lint exited $lint, make test exited $tests. Full output in $logs" >&2
[ "$lint" -eq 0 ] || tail -n 20 "$logs/lint.log" >&2
[ "$tests" -eq 0 ] || tail -n 20 "$logs/test.log" >&2
exit 2
